description: Each post also carries firstCommentResult: null when no first comment applies (or the post is not published yet), otherwise { status: pending|posted|failed|skipped, commentId, skipReason, error: { code, message, platformStatusCode, outcomeUnknown } }. While it is pending, or when error.outcomeUnknown is true, do NOT post the comment yourself (e.g. with linkedin_create_comment): it may already exist. Get post group details, media inventory and platform-specific posts. Each post includes isThread and threadParts (content, index, status, publishedId) and any post-level error to inspect publication progress. After partial publication or an unknown outcome, inspect the parts and live post before taking further action; never blindly recreate the whole thread.
